upload_session.invariant: terminal states never regress; ordinary confirmed is terminal and permanently keeps confirmed_attachment_id; confirmed iff linked

asset_metadata.invariant: history defaults live with gc_verified=false; business status 0/-1 never directly sets delete_intent

business_reference.invariant: same business id replay inserts no duplicate; delete_intent/deleted forbids new references

retention_authorization.invariant: retention only extends; hold none<->held reversible until delete_intent commits, purged irreversible; workspace permanent retention cannot be degraded by TTL or account deletion

blocked: ready ONLY legacy_location_unverified attempts=0 never-leased proof-role full-eligibility re-audit

physical_delete_job.invariant: done permanent tombstone; 8 durable claim attempts then blocked; identity fields immutable after fill

lock_order: 1. existing organization/membership locks -> workspace row FOR UPDATE (EB hold/purge); personal domain skips unrelated parent locks
2. enterprise register/intent/purge UUID xact lock hashtextextended('v5-eb-upload:'||uuid::text,169) AFTER parent/workspace BEFORE identity/asset row locks; multi-UUID byte-sorted
3. cross-domain full identity advisory lock hashtextextended(jsonb_build_array(driver,storage_root_id,container,object_key)::text,1685), canonical alias normalization, byte-sorted multi-object
4. per-domain object xact lock: ordinary hashtextextended(object_key,168) preserving migration-168 trigger domain; enterprise domain+object_key stable key; lock core re-verifies full identity
5. session row -> asset row (id ascending FOR UPDATE) -> governance row (EAR) -> business relation rows (stable business key sorted) -> job row
6. READ COMMITTED default; re-query all eligibility after lock; whole-transaction bounded retry on deadlock/serialization failure

linearization_points.pending_register: INSERT transaction COMMIT; failure or unknown commit returns no usable URL, recovery via registration lookup
linearization_points.confirm: locked legal registered->confirmed + metadata + audit same-transaction COMMIT; real object hash/size verified outside transaction but re-verified under lock; HEAD alone insufficient
linearization_points.new_reference: object lock + asset live + authorization + business relation same-transaction COMMIT; job existing/delete_intent/deleted forbids
linearization_points.delete_intent: parent + object + row locks re-verify GC eligibility, metadata set delete_intent + immutable job snapshot + audit COMMIT; arbitration point vs references and holds
linearization_points.worker: short-transaction CAS lease COMMIT before DELETE; completion by queue PK + lease_token in separate short transaction

hold_linearization: hold commits first: GC must reject. delete_intent commits first: no new hold/retention extension/new reference; explicit already_deleting, never fake hold success then delete. workspace-level later hold covers remaining live objects, receipt lists already-deleted exclusions.
key_lifetime: one key never reassigned to another session/object; deleted metadata or terminal job keeps anti-reuse marker; identical byte hash is not the same object; path tombstone (migration 168) blocks reuse of deleted ordinary paths

storage_interface_frozen.notes: stat maps 404 to not_found; DELETE unknown result is never ok; client never passes driver

authorization_boundary: DB SECURITY DEFINER intent functions owned by NOLOGIN role, fixed search_path, schema-qualified names, REVOKE PUBLIC EXECUTE; business roles no queue DML nor protected column writes; workers claim/ack/reaper only; proof role not SET ROLE-able by runtime; runtime credentials never table owner/superuser
rollback_preconditions: Down blocked when any non-null location/client_upload_id/registration/content/deadline/expiry or intent/tombstone exists (V5_DOWN_BLOCKED_USE_FORWARD_FIX); empty-db Down removes in reverse with owner/dependency check; physical deletion reversible only via pre-verified backup else IRREVERSIBLE
